categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Gisway Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the power and new energy sectors, offering integrated energy services including power consulting and design, power engineering construction, power equipment sales, digital intelligent platform development, and comprehensive energy services centered on photovoltaic, energy storage, and charging solutions. The company provides full lifecycle services from planning, design, construction to operation and maintenance across transmission, transformation, distribution, new energy, and energy storage fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary cloud rendering technology and digital twin 3D engines to develop intelligent digital platforms. It employs advanced technologies such as IoT, big data, AI, and digital twin modeling for battery remote capacity verification, energy management, and smart grid solutions. The production and service delivery follow a project-based approach including EPC contracting, with integrated design, procurement, construction, and commissioning capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include power enterprises, industrial and commercial users, industrial parks, and community energy consumers. The company serves the electric power industry, new energy projects (solar, wind, biomass), energy storage, and smart energy management sectors, focusing on both regional and national markets within China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in Zhejiang Province, China, which accounts for over 80% of its revenue, while also expanding into other provinces. It has subsidiaries and investments primarily within China, with no significant overseas operations reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou Gisway operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, providing consulting, design, engineering construction, equipment sales, and operation and maintenance services. It acts as an EPC contractor and integrated energy service provider, bridging upstream energy generation and downstream energy consumption and management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on strengthening its integrated power service capabilities and digital intelligent platform development. R&D priorities include digital twin technology, energy management optimization, battery health monitoring, smart grid and microgrid technologies, and comprehensive energy service innovations. It emphasizes green, low-carbon energy transition, digitalization, and new energy integration aligned with national energy policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through project-based sales including consulting and design fees, engineering construction contracts (EPC and specialized contracting), equipment sales, digital platform development services, and comprehensive energy service contracts. The company also earns income from market-based retail electricity sales acting as an agent, and leasing income from operating leases.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading private integrated energy service operator in China with comprehensive qualifications and capabilities across the power and new energy sectors. It competes with other domestic power consulting, engineering, and energy service firms, leveraging its digital twin technology and full lifecycle service model to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 673 million, a 30.79% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 35.5 million, a decline from the previous year. It has total assets of RMB 1.465 billion and equity of RMB 962 million, showing steady growth in scale. The company invests around 3.92% of revenue in R&D and maintains positive cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its one-stop integrated energy service offering combining consulting, design, construction, operation, and digital intelligent management platforms with proprietary digital twin technology. Its unique value lies in enabling customers to maximize energy asset value, improve operational efficiency, and achieve green, low-carbon energy transformation through innovative digital and energy management solutions.
